classification.difficultyReason: Follow the directed arrows, apply each supplied operation to both sides, and simplify signed variable terms, including variables introduced on the right. The loop supplies every operation; its length adds repetition rather than strategic demand.

content.prompt: Complete the loop by carrying out the operation shown to both sides of the equation.

spec.description: Ten dotted equation boxes around a hollow centre: three across the top, two intermediate boxes on each side, and three across the bottom. Arrows descend the left side, cross the bottom to the right, ascend the right side and cross the top to the left. Operation labels are above top arrows, below bottom arrows and beside vertical arrows.
spec.mathematics: Starting equation 3n+5=13. Traversal operations: multiply by 2, subtract 5, add 3n, add 4, subtract 2n, subtract 10, subtract n, add 3, divide by 2, add 4.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the starting equation, ten operations and centred equals signs are supplied. Nine 48 mm by 9 mm dotted boxes provide blank handwriting space on both sides of each equals sign.

answer.worked:
Apply each operation to both sides, multiplying or dividing every term when required.
$$\begin{align*}
3n+5&=13\\
6n+10&=26\\
6n+5&=21\\
9n+5&=3n+21\\
9n+9&=3n+25\\
7n+9&=n+25\\
7n-1&=n+15\\
6n-1&=15\\
6n+2&=18\\
3n+1&=9\\
3n+5&=13
\end{align*}$$
The final addition of $4$ returns to the starting equation.

spec.mathematics: Starting equation 4n-3=14. Traversal operations: add 5, add 3n, subtract 8, subtract 5n, add 4, multiply by 3, subtract 3n, subtract 3, divide by 3, add 3n.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the starting equation, ten operations and centred equals signs are supplied. Nine 48 mm by 9 mm dotted boxes provide blank handwriting space on both sides of each equals sign.

answer.worked:
Apply each operation to both sides, multiplying or dividing every term when required.
$$\begin{align*}
4n-3&=14\\
4n+2&=19\\
7n+2&=3n+19\\
7n-6&=3n+11\\
2n-6&=-2n+11\\
2n-2&=-2n+15\\
6n-6&=-6n+45\\
3n-6&=-9n+45\\
3n-9&=-9n+42\\
n-3&=-3n+14\\
4n-3&=14
\end{align*}$$
The final addition of $3n$ returns to the starting equation.
